concerns.text: The plan states “Kruskal‑Wallis test is pre‑specified for all levels (FR‑008).” This contradicts FR‑008 in the specification, which requires a Shapiro‑Wilk normality test and conditional use of Kruskal‑Wallis only if the normality test fails. The plan omits the Shapiro‑Wilk step, violating the functional requirement.
